**What happened**

**Component** (server route, SDK, toll engine, x402 gate, docs)

**Endpoint / function** (e.g. `POST /api/pay/quote`, `calculate_fees`, …)

**Inputs to reproduce** (quote body, tier, chain/token pair)

**Expected vs actual** (attach the JSON response if it is a route)

**Mode** (`mock` / `dryrun` / `broadcast` — see `server/app.py` header)
